title.rendered: Cosplay Mania 2026 Exhibit Booth Slots Now Open!

content.rendered:
🚀 Booth slots for Cosplay Mania 2026 are now LIVE! 🎟️ Join us on 02-04 October 2026 at SMX Convention Center Manila for “Dazzling Diamond”. Prime spots fill up quickly; don’t miss out! Secure yours now by clicking on “Read More”!

What is Cosplay Mania?

Our flagship event and the country’s biggest cosplay event. With dozens of top international Cosplay Celebs, VTubers, Voice Actors and Anime Song Artists, and an exciting JAM Concert features top Japanese artists in an intense concert experience.

Event Highlights

Types of Exhibit Booths

Standard Exhibit Booth

The Standard Exhibit Booths are booths that cater to Micro-Small-Medium Enterprises and Corporations to feature, showcase and sell their goods and services

All-Star Avenue

All-Star Avenue is the event’s exhibit booth for cosplayers, idol groups, performers, and content creators to meet with their fans and supporters.

Food Booth

Food booths cater to food and beverage enterprises to feature and sell different dishes that satisfy the hunger of our audience.

FanFair Table

FanFair is the event’s artist alley. FanFair is a creative avenue for amateur, semi-professional, and professional artists to showcase their work and their fandom.

Photo/Video Exhibit Booth

The Photo/Video Exhibit Booths are designed to cater to enterprising photographers/videographers, enabling them to sell and earn from their passion for the visual arts.

Vendor Registration

Don’t have a vendor account yet? You may get your complimentary account below:

All new applications are manually verified, and it will take 2 to 3 business days for your account to be verified.

Once your account has been verified, you may purchase your slot here.

Already have an account? There is no need to register again; You may purchase your slots once they are available. You only need 1 account to access all of our events.

Important

  1. By purchasing a booth slot, you agree and will abide by the Terms and Conditions
  2. ❗ALL SALES ARE FINAL❗
  3. Booth assignments are conducted by the organizers
  4. For preferred booth names, please input them in the “Company Name” field under the Billing Information section at Checkout. If there’s no Company Name, your name will be used as a default.
  5. All unpaid orders will automatically be cancelled once all available slots are sold.
Contact Marketing/Sales
Interested in getting a booth, sponsoring, or advertising? Or do you have an exhibit/sponsorship-related inquiry? Please fill up the form, and the team will reach out to you.
